mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies while you are out enjoying the Military Ridge State Trail, and keep an eye on that waning crescent moon tonight.

The City of Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This document will guide our city's development over the next decade, focusing on housing, transportation, and building a stronger downtown area.

We have a busy lineup today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House festivities, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run tomorrow or head to the Puppets in the Park event this Saturday.
A notable incident occurred on October 3, where a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested after officers found a stolen firearm inside his vehicle during a traffic stop for expired registration.
It is a great day to stop by Culver's for the Double Strawberry flavor of the day. They are currently open and will be serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
